mapper.select: SELECT ud.user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.employee_no, u.status AS user_status, ud.is_primary, ud.status AS relation_status, ud.position, ud.grant_time FROM user_dept ud INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ud.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ud.dept_id = #{deptId} AND ud.status IN (1, 2) ORDER BY ud.is_primary DESC, ud.grant_time DESC, u.username
SELECT p.id, p.post_code, p.post_name, p.status FROM sys_post p WHERE p.dept_id = #{deptId} AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.order_num, p.post_code

SELECT r.role_code, r.role_name, r.status, r.role_type, gt.grant_time FROM grant_table gt INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_code = gt.role_code WHERE gt.subject_type = 'DEPT' AND gt.subject_id = #{deptId} AND r.role_type IN (3, 4) ORDER BY r.role_code
